def convert_item_or_items_into_compiled_regexes_else_none(items):
    if items is None:
        return None
    
    if isinstance(items, RE_COMPILED_TYPE):
        return [items]
    
    if isinstance(items, strings):
        return [re.compile(items)]
    
    result = []
    for item in items:
        if isinstance(item, RE_COMPILED_TYPE):
            result.append(item)
